name: filtered-manifold-benchmark-balanced-200
description: A balanced 200-example subset of the filtered-manifold benchmark hosted on Hugging Face. Intended as a small, curated test set to probe model behavior across a variety of short NLP instances/tasks (balanced across classes/topics). Typically used for quick robustness or calibration checks rather than large-scale evaluation.
reputation: Small, community-hosted dataset on Hugging Face with limited visibility and adoption beyond niche users.
